pages.title: Mana Ball
pages.text: RuneRegister (RuneRegister), launch position (Vec3) -> Mana Ball -> projectile entity

Order doesn't matter, creates a mana ball and pushes its entity.
Mana cost = number of runes in RuneRegister

On hit, executes the rune fragments in the register as a new spell, pushing the hit coordinate (vec3) onto the new spell stack before execution.

$(6)Additionally, if the mana ball hits a creature, it resets its invincibility frames
